gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 concerns the covariance normalization and domain of the projected noise under missing joint diagonalization. It does not identify the distinct zero-eigenvalue case in which division by sqrt(lambda_k) is undefined, nor does its repair recognize zero modes as identically zero.

The prediction identifies that the projected noise is not standard Wiener under assumptions (i)-(ii) without the joint eigenbasis condition, gives the covariance/normalization failure, and repairs it by adding assumption (iii).
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The coefficient-representation lemma incorrectly claims standard Wiener processes and the associated sqrt(lambda_k) normalization without the joint A-Q eigenbasis assumption; the required covariance calculation is valid only when that condition holds.

component_coverage.gold_component: Under only the separately stated assumptions, the projected processes need not have covariance min(t,s) delta_kj and therefore are not established as independent standard Wiener processes; the joint eigenbasis condition is required.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly computes the variance/covariance normalization failure, notes the possible ill-defined projection and nonstandard Wiener behavior, and supplies the missing joint-eigenbasis assumption as the repair.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The prediction derives the correct C_Delta powers in the eigenvalue bounds, shows that the stated bare-constant choices are unjustified, computes the resulting corrected error constant, and gives the corresponding repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The Laplacian corollary propagates the Weyl constant with incorrect powers when applying the general spectral theorem, so its explicit error constant is unsupported even though the convergence rate is unchanged.

component_coverage.gold_component: The eigenvalue bounds imply C_Delta^alpha and C_Delta^-beta factors, yielding C_Delta^{-beta-(2gamma-1)alpha} rather than the printed C_Delta^{2-2gamma} factor in the explicit error constant.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction independently derives both corrected eigenvalue bounds, identifies the invalid constant choices and wrong printed factor, and states the corrected constant and repair.
